projection_schema_material.applicability: C1-01 scalar direct empirical route only

target.component_material: canonical exact empirical_query.target_arity_and_topology.components[0] material; no dropped topology/domain/authority fields

denominator.weighted_denominator_support_if_authoriz: exact EmpiricalFact weighted denominator object or null

measure.weight_design_estimand_context: exact dereferenced used WeightMeasureFact context when governed weighted, otherwise null

cells.order: preserve producer canonical cell order exactly
cells.raw_probability_exact_fraction: reduce raw_numerator_support/raw_denominator_support; null only when raw denominator is zero
cells.weighted_probability_exact_fraction_if_a: divide exact weighted numerator fraction by exact weighted denominator fraction and reduce; null when measure is RAW or denominator unavailable

fraction_encoding.normalization: greatest-common-divisor reduced; denominator positive; zero represented [0,1]

possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.source_universe_ref: must equal consumer_query.source_universe_ref and sole producer universe ref
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.release_ref: must equal consumer_query.release_ref and sole exact C11 execution release
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.evidence_state: SUPPORTED only for this C1-01 geometry projection; other producer states follow outer-envelope state law and may omit consumer call
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.raw_support: EXACTLY EmpiricalFact.raw_denominator_support; never raw_resolved_target_support and never one cell numerator
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.provenance_refs: must include EmpiricalFact.ref, EmpiricalQuerySpec.ref, EmpiricalPredicate.ref, EmpiricalFact.replay_ref, condition_value_witness_ref, subject_condition_preimage_ref, pairing_ground_truth_ref; canonical ExactRef order
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.authority_refs: canonical union of EmpiricalFact.authority_snapshot_refs and condition-value pairing AuthorityRef
possibility_slice_evidence_mapping.evidence_ref: sha256 identity over the complete PossibilitySliceEvidence payload plus contract id C1_POSITIONED_SUBJECT_SLICE_EVIDENCE@1

fail_closed: if empirical fact state is not losslessly representable as consumer evidence, do not fabricate geometry and set consumer_result null in the outer envelope
ZERO_SUPPORT and ZERO_OVERLAP do not map to SUPPORTED evidence
observed-zero cell in positive denominator remains a SUPPORTED geometry cell with raw_numerator_support=0 and raw_probability_exact_fraction=[0,1]
VALID_EMPTY remains distinct and has no supported geometry
any change to denominator members, measure identity, target component/domain, condition witness, cell material or authority/provenance changes the evidence identity

weighted_rule: C1-01 AT07 is RAW, but the projection schema already freezes weighted slots. A later GOVERNED_WEIGHTED use must carry exact owner-provided weighted numerator/denominator fractions and used WeightMeasureFact design/estimand context; numerical equality with RAW does not alias.
